continuity: Dark Heaven has effectively won the assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan, with the Tang Clan's green-clad defenders largely dead.
Tang Sadok remains alive but gravely wounded and captive on a hill overlooking the Tang Clan, forced to watch its destruction.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has entered the underground prison after at least twenty infiltrators were killed there, and he is now fighting Jin Taekyung.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord intends to capture Jin Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Jeok Cheongang alive for the Blood Lord and take the Myriad-Poison Ring.
Jin Taekyung can sense invisible qi after developing a new sensitivity while fighting Hwangbo Eom; he evaded the Western Heaven Demon Lord's eighth-stage Ghost Prison Finger.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has reattached another person's arm to his body; after ten days it moves almost naturally, though the left arm remains a stated weakness.
Cheongpung is alive and fighting First Fiend at the Tang Clan.
Cheongpung has manifested Sword Force, establishing that he has reached the Supreme Peak realm.
Cheongpung regards Jin Taekyung as his friend and only true martial rival.
plot: Dark Heaven overwhelms the Sichuan Tang Clan. The Western Heaven Demon Lord leaves Tang Sadok alive on a hill to watch the clan's destruction, then enters the underground prison after finding his infiltrators dead and breaks through its walls.

Jin Taekyung confronts the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who intends to take Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Jeok Cheongang alive to the Blood Lord and seize the Myriad-Poison Ring. Taekyung evades the eighth-stage Ghost Prison Finger and launches Heavenly Strike, while Cheongpung recognizes the clash, manifests Sword Force, and challenges First Fiend.
translation_decisions: Render 흑혈검법 as Black Blood Sword Technique.
Render 후발선제 contextually as striking second, hitting first.

active_continuity: Dark Heaven has effectively won the assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan, while fighting continues in the ruined Family Head's Hall.
Tang Sadok is alive but gravely wounded and captive on a hill overlooking the destroyed Tang Clan.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord is fighting Jin Taekyung in the underground prison after his infiltrators were killed there.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord seeks the Myriad-Poison Ring and intends to deliver Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Jeok Cheongang alive to the Blood Lord.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and the Divine Physician remains in the underground prison.
Taekyung has evaded the Western Heaven Demon Lord's eighth-stage Ghost Prison Finger and launched Heavenly Strike.
Cheongpung is alive, has reached Supreme Peak through his manifestation of Sword Force, and is fighting First Fiend.
Cheongpung and Taekyung now recognize each other as friends and true martial rivals.
open_questions: What is the outcome of Taekyung's fight with the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
Can Cheongpung survive his fight with First Fiend?
Can the Tang Clan's remaining forces protect Tang Sadok and the Divine Physician?
What will the Blood Lord do when the Western Heaven Demon Lord brings the survivors or reports the battle?
Can Jeok Cheongang recover before Dark Heaven captures the underground prison?

Render 권강 as Fist Force and 검강 as Sword Force.
Render 흑혈검법 as Black Blood Sword Technique; render 후발선제 contextually as striking second, hitting first.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Unidentified young-seeming man who appears beside Han Su after Han Su flees Shaolin; claims to have killed Hong Dao and says he is Jeok Cheongang's enemy; accepts the Green Jade Buddha Staff, beheads Han Su in a single strike, and declares that the Fire Gate Clan's lineage will end today; recognizes Cheongpung as Huashan's Invincible Divine Sword and as Sword Saint Mae Jonghak's Disciple and grandson; fights Jeok Cheongang, Jin Taekyung, and Cheongpung at Mount Song, cuts apart Jeok's completed Flame Divine Palm, withstands Taekyung's surprise White Flame strike to the chest, regenerates from the catastrophic injuries caused by Jeok's Dance of the Fire God and Demon through demonic martial arts, and reveals that he witnessed the Eight Spring Gorge battle and was responsible for the war that followed; after becoming too injured to regenerate immediately, he overpowers Taekyung and Cheongpung until Jongni Chu is revealed as Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, who attacks him with the divine Thirty-Six Plum Blossom Swords; the Blood Lord loses his remaining arm, bites the Green Jade Buddha Staff, and escapes inside ominous black radiance.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Young-seeming high-ranking Dark Heaven figure who seeks Jin Taekyung, Cheongpung, and Jeok Cheongang after escaping the confrontation at Mount Song.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Young Peak master and Huashan outsider, grandson and Disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, currently fighting First Fiend while defending Tang Sadok at the besieged Sichuan Tang Clan.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Twenty-three-year-old Huashan outsider, grandson and Disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, now a Supreme Peak master fighting First Fiend at the besieged Sichuan Tang Clan.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Mae Jonghak is his grandfather and martial instructor; Baek Museong is his Martial Nephew; Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin are his Benefactors and companions; he now opposes the Blood Lord, the Western Heaven Demon Lord, and First Fiend while defending Tang Sadok.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Mae Jonghak is his grandfather and martial instructor; Baek Museong is his Martial Nephew; Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin are his Benefactors and companions, while Taekyung has become his only true martial rival; he opposes the Blood Lord, the Western Heaven Demon Lord, and First Fiend.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Leader of the Qilian Three Fiends and commander of the Dark Heaven assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan; after killing Tang Jinhu, he is ordered to fight Cheongpung and may kill him if necessary.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Leader of the Qilian Three Fiends and commander of the Dark Heaven assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan, currently fighting Cheongpung after being ordered to kill him if necessary.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who obtained the Myriad-Poison Ring and is currently being treated at the Sichuan Tang Clan alongside his injured Master.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who holds the Myriad-Poison Ring and is confronting the Western Heaven Demon Lord in the Tang Clan's underground prison.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Jin Mukyung is his older brother and fellow martial artist, his mother and sister Hayeon are among the people he protects, Jeok Cheongang is his Master and the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox heir-maker, Cheongpung is his trusted younger-brother-like companion, Song Song remains his same-age friend and guildmate after rejecting his confession, Lee Seowol is a strained political and personal connection, and Won Myunghoon is dead after their alliance collapsed.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Jin Mukyung is his older brother; Jeok Cheongang is his Master; Cheongpung is his trusted companion and only true martial rival; his mother and sister Hayeon are among those he protects.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, gravely wounded and held captive by the Western Heaven Demon Lord during the assault.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan, gravely wounded and held captive on a hill while the Western Heaven Demon Lord forces him to watch the clan's destruction.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Middle-aged Western Heaven Demon Lord, formerly one of the Divine Cult's four Protectors and closest aides to its Cult Leader, who infiltrated the Sichuan Tang Clan as a Green Shadow Squad martial artist, captured Tang Sadok, commands the Dark Heaven assault, and has ordered First Fiend to take Cheongpung alive if possible.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Former Protector of the Divine Cult who commands Dark Heaven's assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan and is now confronting Jin Taekyung in the underground prison while seeking the Myriad-Poison Ring.
